title: Configure enterprise managed authentication for Rovo MCP server
description: Enterprise managed authentication lets organization admins centrally manage how users authorize access to Atlassian apps through the Rovo MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Instead of each user authorizing access individually, you can handle authentication through an identity provider (IdP) like Okta.
